text.en:
There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated,
the sum of ninety-one thousand nine hundred and eleven pesos, to cover deficiencies in the appropriations for
the Philippine Senate and House of Representatives for the year nineteen hundred and twenty-five, said sum to
be distributed as follows:
PHILIPPINE SENATE
For supplementary personnel
For a proportional allowance at the rate of P3,000 per annum to senators elected in special elections, in lieu of
representation expenses, commutable upon the approval of this Act
1,741.67
For miscellaneous expenses
16,466.33
46,428.00
HOUSE OF REPRESENTATIVES
For supplementary personnel
26,659.00
For other services
18,824.00
45,483.00

There is hereby set aside out of the funds appropriated for the consumption of supplies and
materials for the House of Representatives in Act Numbered Thirty-two hundred and seventeen, such sum as
may be necessary for stationery expenses at the rate of one hundred and fifty pesos for each Representative.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, August 14, 1925.
